scope: Read-only source review of known production MP3 and adjacent speech callers. No local functional execution, profiling, browser run, implementation or exhaustive current-source import census.

findings.detail: A fetched official/bundled/archive original is fully inspected by source before readAsset returns; the transport then performs its own worker inspection. The source scan uses inspectMP3 default immediate schedule while acquisition is admitted as fetch, so it can scan during active play.
findings.minimalDesign: Per-read worker inspection callback bound to current transport acquisition, default complete inspection unchanged for offline/export; private successful facts reusable only for exact returned immutable Blob identity; normalize before inspection, keep pinned comparisons, native Blob ownership/size validation, source deadline and transport cancellation. No verified flag/global cache/new worker owner.

findings.detail: Published MP3/WAV cue inspection requires scheduleScan and the real owner uses main admission for each stage. No equivalent direct full-MP3 bypass found here.

Studio import/export/backup/discovery and prepared-library commits scan complete assets. Main onOpen pauses gameplay. Busy Studio tasks prevent normal close; cancellation must settle. Keep default integrity validation. Studio discovery-audio-handoff is another explicit authoring path.

Official cache read path does not call inspectMP3. downloads page explicitly acquires with download:true; source default complete inspection remains required. Do not cancel a separate tab owned installation or replace offline/export validation with a trust flag.

Demo Play Style calls Main prepareSoundtrackLibrary on saved assets and managed audio commit while Demo controls do not pause its clock. Main Solo is covered/paused. Preserve atomic saves; no new implementation in this review.

findings.status: bounded cold-demand work remains unadmitted; no measured hitch
findings.detail: After fetch, demand voice loading invokes inspectReactionRecording directly. It materializes a <=2MiB Blob and parses WAV/M4A outside safe-phase main admission before native metadata/decode. Local saved revisions additionally decode base64 with Uint8Array.from before parser. This is not an MP3 scan or whole-track PCM decode.
findings.fallback: A live cache miss immediately retains caption behavior and schedules preparation for a future occurrence; completion never replays the expired reaction. Failed load returns false and has30s backoff. Owner10s timeout, at most2loads,24buffers,12MiB decoded cache and6MiB per-decode limits remain.
findings.warmup: At most24 relevant current-cast/shared clips, two background workers; new speculative loads stop during playing/suspended and honor prefs/mute/hidden. Main does not await complete warmup in the attempt lease. Thus cannot claim most clips are ready before play.
findings.bound: WAV parser consumes at least8bytes per chunk. For valid<=2MiB WAV with required fmt>=16payload and nonempty data, at most262140 chunk iterations fit; malformed input can enter up to262143 iterations before terminal rejection. M4A has eight fixed boxes() traversals, each capped at2048accepted entries (<=16384 total accepted box objects), plus<=1600stts rows; no unbounded recursion. These are source-derived operation bounds, not timing measurements.
findings.recommendation: Profile cold demanded short shipped clips and large saved clips, including dense valid WAV chunks, before altering live cue readiness. Do not defer all demand to Pause, change recorded-speech prefs, or add another worker/generic service solely from this source review.

limits: No observed millisecond saving or causality claim.
Source-scan fix alone does not close every adjacent media-work path.
No local app/test execution or remote dispatch.
